Kaspary
Kaspary is a Miami-based architecture and interior design studio, renowned for creating premium interiors that blend contemporary aesthetics with timeless European design. Alongside bespoke interior projects, the studio’s furniture brand extends its signature style, reflecting precision, individuality, and refined craftsmanship.
